channel.title: NASA News Releases
channel.description: NASA news releases including launch announcements (snapshot fixture)

item.title: NASA Launches Psyche Mission Aboard SpaceX Falcon Heavy
item.description: NASA's Psyche spacecraft lifted off on a SpaceX Falcon Heavy at 10:19 a.m. EDT from Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

item.title: NASA, ULA Launch Lucy Mission to Trojan Asteroids
item.description: NASA's Lucy spacecraft launched aboard a ULA Atlas V rocket at 5:34 a.m. EDT from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
